newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NOL resumes trade, hits high of S$1.39.
newsitem.headline: NOL resumes trade, hits high of S$1.39.

text.p: Shares of national carrier Neptune Orient Lines Ltd resumed trading on Tuesday, hitting a high of Singapore $1.39 at the market open against its previous close of S$1.20.
The shares were trading at S$1.33 at 0110 GMT. Turnover was a healthy two million units.
Trading of NOL shares were suspended since Friday ahead of its weekend announcement of a US$825 million merger with U.S. container carrier APL Ltd.
Under the takeover, NOL would buy all 24.6 million outstanding APL shares at US$33.50 each, making APL a wholly-owned subsidiary.
News of the acquisition sent APL shares surging over US$9.00 on Monday against its Friday close to a high of US$30.875 on Wall Street. The shares eventually ended at US$29.875.
